main_owners.evidence: One function across four manifest rows. The two mov ip,pc; bx r4 sequences at 0x0800f1ba and 0x0800f1c6 are ordinary indirect calls to the IWRAM-relocated ARM multiply at 0x03000118: mov ip,pc sets the return to the instruction after bx, and both landing sites continue the same live frame. The 62-byte executable-gap row at 0x0800f1bc is the continuation of one statement, not a control-flow anomaly. LAWS.md already records this idiom as a codegen-only difference from bl __call_via_r4. Excluded pools and alignment (90 bytes): 0x0800edf0 (36), 0x0800f186 (30), 0x0800f2ae (18), 0x0800f2d4 (4) and 2 bytes of trailing alignment. Previously recorded as a relocated_kernel_continuation blocker; resolved.

One module: Func_08015fb8 has exactly one caller in the tree (this owner, three sites), so the r9 hand-off is module-internal and is spelled as a third parameter. Its bl Func_080072f0 is a call-via-r3 to the relocated IWRAM helper at 0x03000164. Previously blocked as hidden_register_module; that was a joint-scoping blocker.

Three independent leaf functions inside manifest row 0801c9be, which begins with a two-byte alignment halfword so no owner can start at the row address. None of the three has a prologue and each ends in bx lr; the nearest preceding non-continuation row 0801c8a0 closes on its own return at 0x0801c912 and a gap separates it from this row, so this is not its continuation, and no branch or pool word in the image names any of the three entries. The alignment halfwords at 0x0801c9be, 0x0801c9c2 and 0x0801c9c6, the 2-byte alignment at 0x0801ca16 and the 4-byte pool at 0x0801ca18 are excluded.

Two independent leaf functions inside manifest row 08021dfa, which begins with a two-byte alignment halfword. Neither has a prologue and both end in bx lr. The nearest preceding non-continuation row 08021cb8 is reached only as far as 0x08021d70, where it returns, and the 138 bytes between that and this row are its literal pool, so this row is not its continuation. The alignment halfwords at 0x08021dfa, 0x08021e0e and 0x08021e22 and the pool words at 0x08021e10 and 0x08021e24 are excluded.

One function with its only prologue at 0x08026080 and its only epilogue at 0x08026e72. Direct branches carry the live 324-byte stack frame and r8-r11 state from the head through 0x0802691c into 0x08026b44. The 66-byte gap at 0x080268da, the 2-byte alignment at 0x08026b06, and the 60-byte literal pool at 0x08026b08 are excluded.

Func_080022ec/080022fc are div/mod; page and entry recombine to the integer flag id event-252, corroborated by this owner's own record match. Previously blocked as cross_file_abi against src/080955b0.c, whose void* parameter is semantically mistyped but byte-exact.

One module: r9 = sp+20 is one past this owner's 20-byte local block and the callees' negative offsets from it are header/size/records/result/count, spelled as a struct pointer. Both callees have only this caller. Previously blocked as shared_stack_context_module.

One function with its only prologue at 0x080be378 and its only epilogue at 0x080bf1d4/0x080bf1d6. Direct branches and ten out-of-range bl edges carry the live frame across the rows. The literal pools at 0x080bea9c (108 bytes), 0x080bef58 (48 bytes) and 0x080bf1e8 (32 bytes) are excluded; true executable size is 3,540 bytes.

Blocker premise disproved on both halves: Func_080c1470 clobbers r2 before any read, so it takes one argument; and the 0x03000164 helper is reached with r2 unset at all three sites in the image, so it reads as (destination, length) rather than as intentional callee residue. Previously blocked as implicit_callee_return_state_module.
